_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cruise-line signals

pit_profile.why: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, these six brands operate a combined 44 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 110,900 berths as of December 31, 2015'; 'We compete principally on the basis of exceptional service provided by our crew, innovation and quality of ships, variety of itineraries, choice of destinations and price'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'The demand for cruises is affected by international, national and local economic and geopolitical conditions' (its own FY2015 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, these six brands operate a combined 44 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 110,900 berths as of December 31, 2015'; 'We compete principally on the basis of exceptional service provided by our crew, innovation and quality of ships, variety of itineraries, choice of destinations and price'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'The demand for cruises is affected by international, national and local economic and geopolitical conditions' (its own FY2015 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 2.27x; +23% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.94; conservative 2yr +16%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -73.5%/yr (worst year FY06-FY16, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +6.0%/yr (Q1 cc guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +7.5%/yr (FY06-FY16 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +97.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY06-FY16); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: RCL (retrospective, 2017-02-03) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 2.27x (94.7% downside to Bear $5 / +41.8% upside to Bull $134) | Adj composite 3.13 vs market 2.19: gap +0.94 [UNDERVALUED] | +23% above the EPP floor $77 (11x FY17E $7.00) | Conservative 2-yr case: +16.4% total (+8.2%/yr) | At 13.5x FY17E the 15% hurdle price $125 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; Net Yields +3.4% in Q4 2016, forward net revenue +5.55-6.05% (Q1 2017 net revenue guide at constant currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
